b16999742.desc:
This 1-bedroom apartment for rent in Marina Park, Dubai Marina, offers a practical layout with modern finishes and full furnishing. The unit includes a comfortable bedroom with built-in wardrobes, two bathrooms, an open-plan living and dining area, and a balcony overlooking the pool and marina surroundings. 
Key Features:
• 1 Bedroom
• 2 Bathrooms
• Built-in wardrobe
• Open-plan living area
• Modern kitchen setup
• Balcony/terrace
• Pool view
• Marina and city views
• Garden view
The bedroom features an upholstered bed, large wardrobe with multiple compartments, and a dressing table with mirror. A curtained window brings in natural light, complemented by recessed ceiling lights and a ceiling fan. Bathrooms are finished with marble-effect tiles, pedestal sink, wall-mounted toilet with bidet spray, and a bathtub with overhead rain shower separated by a shower curtain. 
The living and dining space is furnished with a large L-shaped sofa, glass-top or marble-top dining table, and upholstered chairs, set on marble-look floor tiles. The open-plan kitchen and dining area includes white cabinets, a half-height counter and stainless steel refrigerator, with under-cabinet lighting providing a clean, modern feel. The layout supports comfortable day-to-day living with clear zones for lounging and dining. 
The balcony offers a covered outdoor seating area with glass railing, tiled flooring, and space for chairs and a small table. From here, residents can enjoy pool and marina views along with sightlines towards landscaped areas and surrounding modern towers. The outlook includes the courtyard pool with loungers and nearby glass-clad buildings, adding to the urban waterfront atmosphere. 
Marina Park provides a swimming pool and gym for residents, along with covered parking and 24-hour lobby concierge services. High-speed elevators and building electricity backup support smooth daily operations. The property sits within a mixed residential and commercial environment, with ground-floor retail and street-level access to the wider Dubai Marina community. 
Dubai Marina is a pedestrian-friendly waterfront district with direct access to Marina Walk, public transport options such as tram, metro and buses, and a wide range of restaurants, cafes, hotels and retail outlets. Residents of Marina Park benefit from proximity to grocery stores, medical facilities, and leisure attractions including watersport hubs along the marina, making it a convenient base in a central urban location.
